venues.description:
Information about Chinois Ibiza

Located in the former HEART Ibiza venue and inspired by the decadent yet wicked jazz clubs of 1930s Shanghai, Chinois promises to offer old-world hospitality while immersing guests in world-class contemporary entertainment on the sunny shores of Ibiza.


This 3,000-square-meter venue, set to be the island's most anticipated opening, has been meticulously designed by the award-winning Parisian design studio Laleh Assefi. The interiors, bold yet elegant, celebrate the era of Chinoiserie in every tile and table, echoing a time of past grace and charm.


The grand and sumptuous palette is designed to be a sensory feast, and behind its opulent mix of East and West, there is a sense of wit and playfulness, an undeniable tribute to Ibiza’s sacred hedonistic heritage.


Chinois will host international talents, from acclaimed resident DJs to headline superstars and artists, providing an immersive experience to partygoers with the highest production standards.

venues.description:
Information about Es Paradis Ibiza

Es Paradis club, situated on the seafront in San Antonio, is undoubtedly one of the most beautiful clubs in the Mediterranean.




Es Paradis Ibiza opened in 1975 and was created by the artist Lluís Güell, also the creator of Café del Mar




It is built on a huge glass pyramid. Its interior is a spectacular space where the predominant color is the purest white decorated with the most exotic and varied vegetation.


In the hottest suimmer nights, Es paradis can open its roof




The club has two floors with two different rooms, decorated in true Roman style, with columns, palm trees and luxurious marble, predominantly white and very common in Ibiza. It's an icon of the nights in Ibiza and one of those nightclubs that you must visit at least once in your life.




Located in San Antonio, Es Paradis nightclub is focused on a British public, but it is also common to see many residents of the island.




Its most famous and fun party is the Water Party, where water jets are the stars and the dance floor is flooded for everyone to enjoy. In addition, Es Paradis Club presents an extensive calendar of parties and unique experiences every summer




Es Paradis has a wide and diverse offer, three dance floors with three different environments: Café Paradis, The Gallery and the Main Hall. Also it has multiple services: 10 bars, wardrobe, a boutique and four VIP areas

venues.description:
Located between the picturesque hills of Benimussa, in the middle of virgin farmland, lemon orchards, and with elevated views towards the famous sunset in the distance, 528 Ibiza is an impressive blank canvas that invites projecting something magical onto it.



The venue (formerly Benimussa Park) is the perfect setting for the island's most exclusive events, accessible only to a few privileged individuals. It consists of 3 distinct areas:


- Garden: The outdoor area that features bars, gardens, as well as its renowned amphitheater where parties take place.

- Terrace: The ideal place to relax, recharge, and continue the party.

- Theater: The indoor area, renovated in 2021, where private events and gala dinners are held.

.schedule-block{ margin-top:1rem; max-width:760px; }

.schedule-month h3{ margin:0 0 .4em 0; font-size:1rem; }
.schedule-row{ margin:.35em 0; font-size:.95em; }
.schedule-times{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.4rem; margin-top:.25em; }
.time{ background:#fff; padding:.25em .6em; border-radius:6px; font-weight:600; font-size:.85em; }
.schedule-title{ display:inline-block; background:#cce7ff; padding:.4em .8em; border-radius:6px; margin-top:1rem; }
.departure-points{ margin:.35rem 0 1rem 0; line-height:1.5; }
.departure-points a{ font-weight:600; }


Discover Formentera with Sea Experience!


From just €38 (child ticket €19), you can book your seat on this ferry that takes you to Formentera. The journey takes between 50 minutes and 1 hour 15 minutes. You can depart from Figueretas or Playa d'en Bossa, whichever is more convenient for you, as the same boat stops first at the Figueretas pier and 15 minutes later picks up passengers at the Playa d'en Bossa pier.




After sailing with incredible views of Ibiza and Formentera, you will arrive at the port of La Savina in Formentera.




Once on land, you'll find different companies to rent a car, motorbike or bicycle so that you can move freely and explore the whole island.




At the end of the afternoon, you will be able to choose what time you return to Ibiza according to the available timetables.



Ferry Departures


Departure points:
Figueretas Pier (next to Es Xiringuito Figueretas) |
Playa d'en Bossa Pier (in front of Happiness Bar)

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

● The ticket is valid for a same-day round trip.

● The frequency of journeys will increase in mid and high season. Timetables will be updated on your ticket.

● Suitcases are not allowed, only hand luggage.

● Departure points:
Figueretas pier (next to Es Xiringuito Figueretas),
Playa d'en Bossa pier (in front of Happiness Bar).

● Check-in: 30 minutes before departure.

:root{
--brand:#b0eed0;
--blue:#cce7ff;
--lilac:#bbc0f9;
--ink:#151515;
--muted:#667085;
}

.included-row{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:nowrap;
gap:.6rem;
overflow-x:auto;
padding:.4rem .1rem;
margin:.25rem 0 1rem 0;
scroll-snap-type:x proximity;
}
.included-row::-webkit-scrollbar{ display:none; }

.chip{
flex:0 0 auto;
scroll-snap-align:start;
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:.55rem;
padding:.55rem .9rem;
border-radius:10px;
font-weight:600;
font-size:.9rem;
line-height:1.05;
background:transparent;
border:1.5px solid var(--blue);
white-space:nowrap;
color:var(--ink);
}

.icon{
width:32px;
height:32px;
border-radius:50%;
display:grid;
place-items:center;
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
flex-shrink:0;
}

.icon svg{
width:20px;
height:20px;
}

.icon svg.heroicon{
fill:none;
stroke:currentColor;
stroke-width:1.7;
stroke-linecap:round;
stroke-linejoin:round;
vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;
}

.icon svg.drink-icon,
.icon svg.sunset-icon{
width:18px;
height:18px;
fill:currentColor;
stroke:none;
}

.icon svg.music-icon{
width:21px;
height:21px;
}

.icon svg.adults-icon{
width:20px;
height:20px;
fill:none;
stroke:currentColor;
stroke-width:1.7;
stroke-linecap:round;
stroke-linejoin:round;
}

.trip-ticket{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:1fr;
gap:.45rem;
background:linear-gradient(135deg, #eefcf4 0%, #b0eed0 100%);
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.06);
border-radius:14px;
padding:1rem 1rem .95rem;
margin:.2rem 0 1.1rem 0;
box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(21,21,21,.06);
}

.trip-ticket .eyebrow{
font-size:.78rem;
font-weight:700;
text-transform:uppercase;
letter-spacing:.04em;
color:#2f6b4f;
}

.trip-ticket .main{
font-size:1.15rem;
font-weight:800;
color:#151515;
line-height:1.2;
}

.trip-ticket .meta{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:.5rem .7rem;
margin-top:.1rem;
}

.trip-ticket .meta span{
background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
border-radius:999px;
padding:.38rem .7rem;
font-size:.9rem;
font-weight:600;
color:#151515;
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.05);
}

.trip-ticket .season{
font-size:.92rem;
color:#355070;
line-height:1.45;
margin-top:.15rem;
}

.detalles{ margin:1rem 0; }
.detalles summary{ list-style:none; cursor:pointer; display:inline-block; }
.detalles summary::-webkit-details-marker{ display:none; }

.pill{
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:.6em;
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
padding:.4em .8em;
border-radius:6px;
line-height:1.1;
}

.pill::after{
content:"+";
width:1.3em;
height:1.3em;
border-radius:50%;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.65);
color:var(--ink);
font-weight:700;
font-size:.9em;
display:grid;
place-items:center;
}

details[open] .pill::after{ content:"–"; }

.contenido{
margin-top:.6em;
margin-left:.2em;
animation:fadeIn .25s ease;
}

@keyframes fadeIn{
from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(-4px)}
to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0)}
}

.cubiculo-lista{
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
gap:.45em;
}

.cubiculo{
background:var(--lilac);
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.05);
border-radius:10px;
padding:.6em .9em;
font:inherit;
color:var(--ink);
line-height:inherit;
}

.itinerary-block{
--line:var(--lilac);
--dot:var(--ink);
position:relative;
padding:8px 4px 4px 4px;
}

.itinerary-block *{ box-sizing:border-box; }

.itinerary-block .title{
margin:0 0 .6rem 12px;
color:var(--ink);
font-size:1.2rem;
font-weight:700;
}

.itinerary-block .list{
position:relative;
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:56px 1fr;
row-gap:26px;
padding:18px 0;
}

.itinerary-block .line{
position:absolute;
left:28px;
transform:translateX(-3px);
border-left:6px dotted var(--line);
top:18px;
height:0;
pointer-events:none;
}

.itinerary-block .item{ display:contents; }
.itinerary-block .cell-left{ grid-column:1; position:relative; }

.itinerary-block .icon-wrap{
width:36px;
height:36px;
border-radius:50%;
background:#fff;
border:3px solid var(--line);
margin-left:10px;
box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
}

.itinerary-block .badge{
width:26px;
height:26px;
border-radius:50%;
background:var(--dot);
color:#fff;
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
line-height:0;
}

.itinerary-block .badge svg{
width:15px;
height:15px;
display:block;
}

.itinerary-block .cell-right{ grid-column:2; }

.itinerary-block .h{
font-weight:800;
color:var(--dot);
margin:0 0 .1rem 0;
}

.itinerary-block .sub{
color:var(--muted);
margin:0 0 .35rem 0;
font-size:.94rem;
}

.itinerary-block .cta{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:.45rem .7rem;
margin-bottom:.1rem;
}

.itinerary-block .cta a{
text-decoration:underline;
font-weight:600;
color:var(--dot);

Cala Conta: 1 hour of free time to explore at your leisure.

Departure point

Quiet cove · Swim stop

Second 1-hour stop with free time to enjoy Cala Conta at your own pace.

Cala Salada Cruise is a 6-hour boat excursion departing from San Antonio from 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM. You will sail towards the north of the island with a first stop at the natural aquarium of Cap Blanc, where the boat stops for 30 minutes and entry is included. You will then continue to the islands of Ses Margalides and the peaceful area of Ses Balandres, where there will be an extended stop for swimming, sunbathing, snorkelling or bodyboarding. At around 1:15 PM, the boat will arrive at Cala Salada and Cala Saladeta, where you can get off to explore the beach or stay on board if you prefer.




All the information about Cala Salada Cruise


What’s included?


6-hour boat trip from 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Visit to Cap Blanc Aquarium with entry included.

Stop at Cala Salada and Cala Saladeta.

Food on board: fresh fruit, sweets and pastries.

Drinks included: sangria, beer, cava, soft drinks and water.

Water sports and activities: bodyboards, donuts, floating mats and snorkelling.

Glass-bottom boat with submarine vision.

San Antonio Port, near Palapa Bar and in front of the egg roundabout.

(function(){
function recalc(){
const list = document.getElementById('itList');
const line = document.getElementById('itLine');
if(!list || !line) return;

const icons = list.querySelectorAll('.icon-wrap');
if(icons.length < 2) { line.style.height = '0px'; return; }

const first = icons[0].getBoundingClientRect();
const last = icons[icons.length-1].getBoundingClientRect();
const box = list.getBoundingClientRect();

const y1 = (first.top - box.top) + first.height/2;
const y2 = (last.top - box.top) + last.height/2;
line.style.top = y1 + 'px';
line.style.height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(recalc, 0), { once:true });
window.addEventListener('resize', recalc);
document.querySelectorAll('.detalles').forEach(d => d.addEventListener('toggle', recalc));
const listEl = document.getElementById('itList');
if(listEl) new MutationObserver(recalc).observe(listEl, {subtree:true, childList:true});
})();

events.name: San Antonio to Es Vedrà Boat Trip - Sunset
events.description:
Visit one of the most beautiful and magical natural environments on the coast of Ibiza. During this 4-hour Cruise you will be able to discover numerous coves of Ibiza.


The excursion begins with a scenic journey towards Es Vedrà, the island’s largest and most iconic natural reserve. Along the way, you’ll enjoy breathtaking views of some of Ibiza’s most beautiful coves, including Port des Torrent, Cala Bassa, Cala Conta, Cala Tarida, Cala Molí, Cala Vadella, Cala Carbó and Cala d’Hort.



Once you reach Es Vedrà, the boat sails around this spectacular natural landmark while the crew explains its history and legends. Afterwards, depending on sea conditions, you head towards Cala Conta or Cala Bassa, where you can stop for a refreshing swim in crystal-clear waters before making your way back to the port of San Antonio.



The price includes drinks and Finger Food and enjoying one of the best sunsets in the world on your way back to port.




What's included?

- 4h Boat trip from San Antonio to Es Vedrà (4.00pm-8.00pm)


- Sunset


- Local guide on board


- Drinks (water, soft drinks, sangria, white wine and beer)


- Finger Food


- Swim stop at Cala Bassa or Cala Conta (dependig on sea conditions)


- Underwater vision




What to expect San Antonio to Es Vedrà Boat Trip Sunset

Visit one of the most beautiful natural environments in Ibiza. Departing from San Antonio, throughout the route you can admire the beaches of Cala Bassa, Cala Conta, Cala Molí, Cala Vadella, Cala Carbó and Cala D'Hort and the islands of Conejera, del Bosque, Ses Bledes, S'Espartà and Es Vedrà.




Important Information

- Departure from San Antonio port, Captain Nemo kiosk (See map)


- Departure times may vary depending on the time of year


- Recommended for all ages


- There will be a swim stop, so you must bring a swim suit and towel. Bring sun protection, sunglasses, sunscreen, a hat...




If you would like to enjoy this excursion but in the morning, you can book your place here: San Antonio to Es Vedrà Boat Trip Daytime

events.description:
Natural Park Aquarium is a 3 hour boat trip departing from San Antonio from 11:00am to 2:00pm. A trip to the northwest of the island of Ibiza. The first stop is the Cap Blanc Aquarium, an old lobster nursery inside a cave that houses different species endemic to the Pityusic sea. During this route you will see different coves such as Cala Gració, Cala Gracioneta, Cala Salada, Cala Saladeta and Punta Galera. Finally you reach the Margaritas Islands, a nature reserve off the coast of Ses Balandres. It is here that we make a swim stop of approximately 45 minutes where you can use the different aquatic equipment. After the swim stop, you will enjoy a small snack of fruit and salty snacks.




What's included?

· 3h Boat trip (11:00am - 2:00pm)

· Drinks (water, soft drinks, sangria, white wine and beer)

· Fruits and salty snacks


· Swim stop


· Glass bottom boat and snorkelling


· Visit to the Cap Blanc Aquarium

7–8 hour guided tour








Hotel pickup and drop-off






Island tour of Ibiza








Visit to a hippie market





Multilingual guide



Ibiza bus tour

Island tour of Ibiza · Hippie market, viewpoints and traditional villages


Duration: 7–8 hours
Departure from 9:00 am
Hotel pickup included



About the Ibiza Bus Tour


Let yourself be carried away on a journey that reveals Ibiza’s best-kept secrets. This bus tour around the island visits some of Ibiza’s most iconic spots, including Las Salinas, the Es Vedrà viewpoint, a traditional Ibizan village, and one of the most famous hippie markets on the island. It also includes hotel pickup and drop-off, making it a very convenient option to explore Ibiza in a single day.





All the information about the Ibiza Bus Tour


What’s included?


7–8 hour guided bus tour around the island of Ibiza.

Hotel pickup and drop-off. Important: the meeting point must be confirmed in advance with the company.

On-board guide in Spanish, English, German, French, Dutch and Italian.

Visit to a hippie market: Punta Arabí (Wednesday) or Las Dalias (Saturday).

Important: you must inform the company of your chosen language.






Departure point



The meeting point must be confirmed directly with the company. The tour includes a pickup and drop-off transfer for most hotels on the island of Ibiza.






Schedule and pickups



Tour start time: From approximately 9:20 am.


Transfer pickup: the exact time will depend on the area where you are staying.


Important: on Saturdays there is no pickup in Cala Tarida, Cala Vadella, Portinatx and San Miguel.






Itinerary


View your route













Pickup and tour departure

The experience begins with the previously agreed pickup and departure by bus around 9:00 am.














Ibiza Town · panoramic introduction

A first introduction to the island with a panoramic view of Ibiza Town and allocation to buses according to the chosen language.














Las Salinas · stop

Discover one of Ibiza’s most famous areas, known for its scenery, natural value and unique views.














Es Vedrà viewpoint · panoramic stop

Stop at one of the island’s most iconic viewpoints to admire the views of Es Vedrà.














Traditional Ibizan village · San José or Santa Gertrudis

Walk through one of the island’s most charming villages and discover a more authentic and traditional Ibiza.














Portinatx / San Miguel / Cala San Vicente · free time

Stop to enjoy the surroundings and have free time for lunch. Meal is not included.














Hippie market · Punta Arabí / Las Dalias

Enjoy free time at one of Ibiza’s most iconic hippie markets: Punta Arabí on Wednesdays or Las Dalias on Saturdays.














Return to hotels

After a full day touring the island, the tour ends with the return transfer.











Important information


Departure point: you must contact the company to confirm the exact meeting point.

Transfer included for most hotels on the island of Ibiza.

Tour departure time:From approximately 9:20 am.

Pickup time: may vary depending on the location of your accommodation.

Important: you must inform the company of the language in which you wish to take the excursion. Languages available on board: Spanish, English, German, French, Dutch and Italian.

No Saturday pickup in Cala Tarida, Cala Vadella, Portinatx and San Miguel.

Meal not included during the free time stop.

(function(){
function recalc(){
const list = document.getElementById('itList');
const line = document.getElementById('itLine');
if(!list || !line) return;

const icons = list.querySelectorAll('.icon-wrap');
if(icons.length < 2) { line.style.height = '0px'; return; }

const first = icons[0].getBoundingClientRect();
const last = icons[icons.length-1].getBoundingClientRect();
const box = list.getBoundingClientRect();

const y1 = (first.top - box.top) + first.height/2;
const y2 = (last.top - box.top) + last.height/2;
line.style.top = y1 + 'px';
line.style.height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(recalc, 0), { once:true });
window.addEventListener('resize', recalc);
document.querySelectorAll('.detalles').forEach(d => d.addEventListener('toggle', recalc));
const listEl = document.getElementById('itList');
if(listEl) new MutationObserver(recalc).observe(listEl, {subtree:true, childList:true});
})();

:root{
--brand:#b0eed0;
--blue:#cce7ff;
--lilac:#bbc0f9;
--ink:#151515;
--soft:#f2f2f2;
--muted:#667085;
}

/* ========= Base styles ========= */

.included-row{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:nowrap;
gap:.6rem;
overflow-x:auto;
padding:.4rem .1rem;
margin:.25rem 0 1rem 0;
scroll-snap-type:x proximity;
}
.included-row::-webkit-scrollbar{ display:none; }

.chip{
flex:0 0 auto;
scroll-snap-align:start;
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:.55rem;
padding:.55rem .9rem;
border-radius:10px;
font-weight:600;
font-size:.9rem;
line-height:1.05;
background:transparent;
border:1.5px solid var(--blue);
white-space:nowrap;
color:var(--ink);
}

.icon{
width:32px;
height:32px;
border-radius:50%;
display:grid;
place-items:center;
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
flex-shrink:0;
}

.icon svg{
width:20px;
height:20px;
}

.icon svg.heroicon{
fill:none;
stroke:currentColor;
stroke-width:1.7;
stroke-linecap:round;
stroke-linejoin:round;
vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;
}

.icon svg.drink-icon{
width:18px;
height:18px;
fill:currentColor;
stroke:none;
}

.icon svg.food-icon{
width:18px;
height:18px;
fill:currentColor;
stroke:none;
}

.icon svg.snorkel-icon{
width:20px;
height:20px;
fill:currentColor;
stroke:none;
}

.icon svg.music-icon{
width:21px;
height:21px;
}

.icon svg.sunset-icon{
width:20px;
height:20px;
fill:none;
stroke:currentColor;
stroke-width:1.8;
stroke-linecap:round;
stroke-linejoin:round;
}

.detalles{ margin:1rem 0; }
.detalles summary{ list-style:none; cursor:pointer; display:inline-block; }
.detalles summary::-webkit-details-marker{ display:none; }

.pill{
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:.6em;
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
padding:.4em .8em;
border-radius:6px;
line-height:1.1;
}

.pill::after{
content:"+";
width:1.3em;
height:1.3em;
border-radius:50%;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.65);
color:var(--ink);
font-weight:700;
font-size:.9em;
display:grid;
place-items:center;
}

details[open] .pill::after{ content:"–"; }

.contenido{
margin-top:.6em;
margin-left:.2em;
animation:fadeIn .25s ease;
}

@keyframes fadeIn{
from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(-4px)}
to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0)}
}

.cubiculo-lista{
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
gap:.45em;
}

.cubiculo{
background:var(--lilac);
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.05);
border-radius:10px;
padding:.6em .9em;
font:inherit;
color:var(--ink);
line-height:inherit;
}

.mapa-destacado{
background:var(--blue);
color:var(--ink);
border-radius:8px;
padding:.6em .9em;
font-size:.95em;
line-height:1.4;
margin-top:.6em;
}

/* ========= Itinerary ========= */

.itinerary-block{
--line:var(--lilac);
--dot:var(--ink);
position:relative;
padding:8px 4px 4px 4px;
}

.itinerary-block *{ box-sizing:border-box; }

.itinerary-block .title{
margin:0 0 .6rem 12px;
color:var(--ink);
font-size:1.2rem;
font-weight:700;
}

.itinerary-block .list{
position:relative;
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:56px 1fr;
row-gap:26px;
padding:18px 0;
}

.itinerary-block .line{
position:absolute;
left:28px;
transform:translateX(-3px);
border-left:6px dotted var(--line);
top:18px;
height:0;
pointer-events:none;
}

.itinerary-block .item{ display:contents; }
.itinerary-block .cell-left{ grid-column:1; position:relative; }

.itinerary-block .icon-wrap{
width:36px;
height:36px;
border-radius:50%;
background:#fff;
border:3px solid var(--line);
margin-left:10px;
box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
}

.itinerary-block .badge{
width:26px;
height:26px;
border-radius:50%;
background:var(--dot);
color:#fff;
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
line-height:0;
}

.itinerary-block .badge svg{
width:15px;
height:15px;
display:block;
}

.itinerary-block .cell-right{ grid-column:2; }

.itinerary-block .h{
font-weight:800;
color:var(--dot);
margin:0 0 .1rem 0;
}

.itinerary-block .sub{
color:var(--muted);
margin:0 0 .35rem 0;
font-size:.94rem;
}

.itinerary-block .cta{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:.45rem .7rem;
margin-bottom:.1rem;
}

.itinerary-block .cta a{
text-decoration:underline;
font-weight:600;
color:var(--dot);
}

/* === Remove blue focus halo === */

.detalles summary,
.detalles summary *{
outline:none!important;
box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}

.detalles summary:focus,
.detalles summary:focus-visible,
.detalles summary:active,
.detalles summary:focus-within,
.detalles[open]>summary:focus,
.detalles[open]>summary:focus-visible,
.detalles summary:focus-visible>.pill,
.detalles summary:focus>.pill{
outline:none!important;
box-shadow:none!important;
-webkit-box-shadow:none!important;
}

.detalles summary::-moz-focus-inner{ border:0!important; }

/* ========= Ticket ========= */

.trip-ticket{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:1fr;
gap:.45rem;
background:linear-gradient(135deg, #eefcf4 0%, #b0eed0 100%);
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.06);
border-radius:14px;
padding:1rem 1rem .95rem;
margin:.2rem 0 1.1rem 0;
box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(21,21,21,.06);
}

.trip-ticket .eyebrow{
font-size:.78rem;
font-weight:700;
text-transform:uppercase;
letter-spacing:.04em;
color:#2f6b4f;
}

.trip-ticket .main{
font-size:1.15rem;
font-weight:800;
color:#151515;
line-height:1.2;
}

.trip-ticket .meta{
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:.5rem .7rem;
margin-top:.1rem;
}

.trip-ticket .meta span{
background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
border-radius:999px;
padding:.38rem .7rem;
font-size:.9rem;
font-weight:600;
color:#151515;
border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.05);
}

.trip-ticket .season{
font-size:.92rem;
color:#355070;
line-height:1.45;
margin-top:.15rem;
}

@media (min-width: 900px){
.cubiculo-mapa{
max-width:760px;
margin-left:auto;
margin-right:auto;
}

.included-row{
flex-wrap:wrap;
overflow-x:visible;
gap:1.2rem 1.2rem;
margin:.55rem 0 1.45rem 0;
padding:.25rem 0;
}

.chip{
margin-bottom:.2rem;
padding:.82rem 1.3rem;
font-size:1rem;
border-radius:14px;
gap:.78rem;
}

.icon{
width:38px;
height:38px;
}

.icon svg{
width:22px;
height:22px;
}

.icon svg.drink-icon,
.icon svg.food-icon{
width:19px;
height:19px;
}

.icon svg.snorkel-icon{
width:21px;
height:21px;
}

.icon svg.music-icon{
width:23px;
height:23px;
}

.icon svg.sunset-icon{
width:22px;
height:22px;
}

.trip-ticket{
padding:1.45rem 1.6rem 1.35rem;
border-radius:20px;
margin:.45rem 0 1.5rem 0;
gap:.8rem;
}

.trip-ticket .eyebrow{
font-size:.9rem;
}

.trip-ticket .main{
font-size:1.7rem;
line-height:1.15;
max-width:900px;
}

.trip-ticket .meta{
gap:.7rem .8rem;
margin-top:.2rem;
}

.trip-ticket .meta span{
font-size:1rem;
padding:.52rem .95rem;
}

.trip-ticket .season{
font-size:1rem;
}
}

Enjoy a unique experience in the most innovative botanical park in Europe. A place to observe, learn, relax and enjoy the nature of Ibiza and Formentera through biotechnology.

(function(){
function recalc(){
const list = document.getElementById('itList');
const line = document.getElementById('itLine');
if(!list || !line) return;

const icons = list.querySelectorAll('.icon-wrap');
if(icons.length < 2) { line.style.height = '0px'; return; }

const first = icons[0].getBoundingClientRect();
const last = icons[icons.length-1].getBoundingClientRect();
const box = list.getBoundingClientRect();

const y1 = (first.top - box.top) + first.height/2;
const y2 = (last.top - box.top) + last.height/2;
line.style.top = y1 + 'px';
line.style.height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1) + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(recalc, 0), { once:true });
window.addEventListener('resize', recalc);
document.querySelectorAll('.detalles').forEach(d => d.addEventListener('toggle', recalc));
const listEl = document.getElementById('itList');
if(listEl) new MutationObserver(recalc).observe(listEl, {subtree:true, childList:true});
})();

4x4 Safari tour






6.5h experience






Hidden Ibiza spots





Snorkel equipment






Photos & videos










Sunset at Cala Conta



Into the Island · 4x4 Safari

Discover the southwest of Ibiza by Land Rover 4x4 Defender


Duration: approx. 6.5 hours
Approx. 2:45 PM · afternoon only
Groups up to 7–8 people



About Into the Island 4x4 Safari


Discover the best hidden spots on the island of Ibiza with Into the Island.
This 4x4 Safari takes you in a Land Rover 4x4 Defender, accompanied by one of our local guides,
on an extended route through the southwest of Ibiza.



The experience now lasts approximately 6.5 hours, allowing more time at each stop and a more complete view
of this part of the island. Along the route, you’ll visit Es Cubells, Es Vedrà, Cala d’Hort,
Cala Tarida, the Sa Figuera Borda cave, Time & Space and the Doors of Cala Llentia.



The tour finishes at the Cala Comte viewpoint, where you’ll enjoy the sunset. This new format combines
beaches, viewpoints, hidden spots, cultural landmarks and sunset in one complete 4x4 experience.





All the information about Into the Island 4x4 Safari


What’s included?


Approx. 6.5-hour 4x4 Safari in a Land Rover Defender.

Local guide throughout the experience.

Insurance included.

Photos and videos included.

Snorkel equipment for the swim stop.

Route through hidden spots in the southwest of Ibiza.

Stops at Es Cubells, Es Vedrà, Cala d’Hort, Cala Tarida, Sa Figuera Borda, Time & Space, Cala Llentia and Cala Comte.






Pick-up & drop-off



Pick-up point: Ibiza Town, Club Náutico.


Drop-off: return at Ibiza Town or Eroski Ses Païsses.






Times & group size


Duration: approximately 6 hours and 30 minutes.

Departure: approximately 2:45 PM, may vary depending on the sunset time.

Group size: up to 7–8 people.






Itinerary


Visualize your route














Pick-up in Ibiza Town

Meet your guide and get ready to explore southwest Ibiza in a Land Rover 4x4 Defender.














Es Cubells

Discover this beautiful village in the south of Ibiza and enjoy the first stop of the extended route.














Es Vedrà

See Ibiza’s iconic and mystical rock formation from one of the island’s most spectacular areas.














Cala d’Hort

Visit one of Ibiza’s most emblematic beaches, with impressive views towards Es Vedrà.














Cala Tarida

Discover one of the west coast’s best-known beaches and its turquoise Mediterranean waters.














Sa Figuera Borda cave

Explore this unique cave and hidden coastal spot in the southwest of Ibiza.














Time & Space

Visit one of Ibiza’s most unusual cultural landmarks in a striking natural setting.














Doors of Cala Llentia

Discover the famous doors overlooking the Mediterranean near Cala Llentia.














Cala Conta viewpoint · Sunset

Finish the tour at the Cala Conta viewpoint and enjoy the sunset over the sea.











Important information


Duration: approximately 6 hours and 30 minutes.

Departure: approximately 2:45 PM, afternoon only, depending on sunset time.

Groups: up to 7–8 people.

Pick-up point: Ibiza Town only.

Drop-off: return at Ibiza Town or Eroski Ses Païsses.

Included: insurance, guide, photos and videos, and snorkel equipment.

Into the Island · Combo Tour

Boat Trip + 4x4 Safari + Hike + Sunset Picnic in front of Es Vedrà


7–8 hours
Pick-up at 2:30 PM
Ibiza Town & San Antonio harbour



About the Into the Island Combo Tour


There is no better way to discover Ibiza than by land and sea.
This full-day Into the Island experience combines a boat trip, a 4x4 safari, a hike and a magical sunset picnic in front of Es Vedrà.



The adventure starts aboard a powerful semi-rigid boat from San Antonio harbour, sailing through crystal-clear waters, passing the famous “Heaven’s Door” and stopping at hidden spots for swimming and snorkelling.



After the boat trip, continue the journey in a safari-style Land Rover Defender 4x4, exploring secret viewpoints and off-road tracks across the southwest of Ibiza before ending the day with a 1-hour hike and sunset picnic facing the iconic rock of Es Vedrà.





All the information about the Combo Tour


What’s included?


Boat trip with swimming and snorkelling stops.

4x4 safari in a Land Rover Defender.

1-hour hike with secret Es Vedrà viewpoints.

Sunset picnic with homemade sangria.

2 guides who speak Spanish, French and English.

Boat with skipper.

4x4 with driver.

Water, soft drinks and beer onboard.

Snorkelling equipment.

HQ photos and videos.

Insurance included.






Pick-up & drop-off


Pick-up time: around 2:30 PM, depending on the sunset time.

Transfer included from: Ibiza Town and San Antonio harbour.

Drop-off: Ibiza Town.






Prices


Adult price: €250 per adult.

Child price: €175 per child aged 4–11 years.






Itinerary


Visualize your route














Boat trip · Heaven’s Door & hidden spots

Sail from San Antonio harbour, pass Heaven’s Door and stop at secret places for swimming, snorkelling and drinks aboard.














4x4 Safari · Southwest Ibiza

Explore inaccessible off-road tracks and spectacular viewpoints in a safari-style Land Rover Defender.














1-hour hike · Es Vedrà viewpoints

Walk along rocky paths to discover the most beautiful and secret viewpoints facing Es Vedrà.














Sunset picnic in front of Es Vedrà

End the day with a magical sunset picnic and homemade sangria prepared by a catering service.











Important information


Duration: 7–8 hours.

Pick-up: around 2:30 PM depending on sunset time.

Transfer included from: Ibiza Town and San Antonio harbour.

Drop-off: Ibiza Town.

Includes: boat trip, 4x4 safari, hike, sunset picnic, snorkelling equipment, drinks, photos and videos.

Languages: Spanish, French and English guides.

BOAT CHILLI PEPPER - CHILLOUT BOAT


10:00 – 13:00
14:00 – 17:00
18:00 – 21:00



About the Chilli Pepper Boat trip


Experience the Chilli Pepper, a boat trip on a classic llaüt around the bay of San Antonio and the most beautiful beaches on the west coast of Ibiza.




Along the way, there is time to swim in crystal-clear water, relax on deck and simply enjoy the peaceful feeling of being surrounded by the sea.




For around three hours, we cruise through the stunning Bay of San Antonio, discovering hidden coves, turquoise waters and dramatic cliffs that define Ibiza’s west coast.




Discover the best hidden spots in Ibiza with a chill out style décor, music and a great atmosphere.






All the information about Chilli Pepper Boat


What's included?


Boat trip on a llaüt departing from San Antonio.

Drinks included: sangria, beer, soft drinks and water.

Spanish tapas and fresh fruit served on board.

Water activities and time to swim in crystal-clear waters.

Secret caves and hidden coastal spots along the route.

Music on board with a relaxed chill out atmosphere.






Departure point



Departure from the Port of Sant Antoni de Portmany.






Check-in


Check-in: 30 minutes before each departure.


Address: Carrer del Far 6, San Antonio de Portmany 07820.
See map






Itinerary


Visualize your route
















Departure from San Antonio

Board the traditional Ibizan llaüt at the port of San Antonio and begin your relaxed cruise along Ibiza’s west coast.
















Cruise through San Antonio Bay

Enjoy the calm bay, music on board and views of the coastline before heading towards Ibiza’s west coast beaches.
















Cala Bassa, Cala Conta & secret caves

The usual route visits Cala Bassa, Cala Conta and secret caves, with turquoise waters and beautiful coastal scenery.
















Alternative route to Cala Salada

If wind or sea conditions are unfavourable, the captain may change the route towards Cala Salada and nearby sheltered coves.
















Swimming stop, tapas & drinks

Stop to swim, relax on deck and enjoy Spanish tapas, fresh fruit and drinks included during the trip.
















Return to San Antonio

Head back to port after around three hours at sea, having enjoyed one of Ibiza’s most relaxed boat experiences.











Important information


Check-in: 30 minutes before each departure.

Departures: 10:00 / 14:00 / 18:00.

Duration: around 3 hours.

Route: normally Cala Bassa, Cala Conta and secret caves.

Weather policy: the route may change to Cala Salada if wind or sea conditions are unfavourable.

Discover Formentera with Sea Experience!


From just €38 (child ticket €19), you can book your seat on this ferry that takes you to Formentera. The journey takes between 50 minutes and 1 hour 15 minutes. You can depart from Figueretas or Playa d'en Bossa, whichever is more convenient for you, as the same boat stops first at the Figueretas pier and 15 minutes later picks up passengers at the Playa d'en Bossa pier.




After sailing with incredible views of Ibiza and Formentera, you will arrive at the port of La Savina in Formentera.




Once on land, you'll find different companies to rent a car, motorbike or bicycle so that you can move freely and explore the whole island.




At the end of the afternoon, you will be able to choose what time you return to Ibiza according to the available timetables.

events.name: San Antonio to Es Vedrà Boat Trip - Sunset
events.description:
Visit one of the most beautiful and magical natural environments on the coast of Ibiza. During this 4-hour Cruise you will be able to discover numerous coves of Ibiza.


The excursion begins with a scenic journey towards Es Vedrà, the island’s largest and most iconic natural reserve. Along the way, you’ll enjoy breathtaking views of some of Ibiza’s most beautiful coves, including Port des Torrent, Cala Bassa, Cala Conta, Cala Tarida, Cala Molí, Cala Vadella, Cala Carbó and Cala d’Hort.



Once you reach Es Vedrà, the boat sails around this spectacular natural landmark while the crew explains its history and legends. Afterwards, depending on sea conditions, you head towards Cala Conta or Cala Bassa, where you can stop for a refreshing swim in crystal-clear waters before making your way back to the port of San Antonio.



The price includes drinks and Finger Food and enjoying one of the best sunsets in the world on your way back to port.




What's included?

- 4h Boat trip from San Antonio to Es Vedrà (4.00pm-8.00pm)


- Sunset


- Local guide on board


- Drinks (water, soft drinks, sangria, white wine and beer)


- Finger Food

Discover the best hidden spots on the island of Ibiza with Into the Island.

Cala Tarida, the Sa Figuera Borda cave, Time & Space and the Doors of Cala Llentia.



The tour finishes at the Cala Comte viewpoint, where you’ll enjoy the sunset. This new format combines
beaches, viewpoints, hidden spots, cultural landmarks and sunset in one complete 4x4 experience.

Discover one of the west coast’s best-known beaches and its turquoise Mediterranean waters.

Explore this unique cave and hidden coastal spot in the southwest of Ibiza.

Visit one of Ibiza’s most unusual cultural landmarks in a striking natural setting.

There is no better way to discover Ibiza than by land and sea.
This full-day Into the Island experience combines a boat trip, a 4x4 safari, a hike and a magical sunset picnic in front of Es Vedrà.



The adventure starts aboard a powerful semi-rigid boat from San Antonio harbour, sailing through crystal-clear waters, passing the famous “Heaven’s Door” and stopping at hidden spots for swimming and snorkelling.



After the boat trip, continue the journey in a safari-style Land Rover Defender 4x4, exploring secret viewpoints and off-road tracks across the southwest of Ibiza before ending the day with a 1-hour hike and sunset picnic facing the iconic rock of Es Vedrà.

About the Chilli Pepper Boat trip


Experience the Chilli Pepper, a boat trip on a classic llaüt around the bay of San Antonio and the most beautiful beaches on the west coast of Ibiza.




Along the way, there is time to swim in crystal-clear water, relax on deck and simply enjoy the peaceful feeling of being surrounded by the sea.




For around three hours, we cruise through the stunning Bay of San Antonio, discovering hidden coves, turquoise waters and dramatic cliffs that define Ibiza’s west coast.




Discover the best hidden spots in Ibiza with a chill out style décor, music and a great atmosphere.






All the information about Chilli Pepper Boat

What's included?


Boat trip on a llaüt departing from San Antonio.

Drinks included: sangria, beer, soft drinks and water.

Spanish tapas and fresh fruit served on board.

Water activities and time to swim in crystal-clear waters.

Secret caves and hidden coastal spots along the route.

Music on board with a relaxed chill out atmosphere.




Departure point



Departure from the Port of Sant Antoni de Portmany.




Check-in


Check-in: 30 minutes before each departure.


Address: Carrer del Far 6, San Antonio de Portmany 07820.
See map




Itinerary


Visualize your route














Departure from San Antonio

Board the traditional Ibizan llaüt at the port of San Antonio and begin your relaxed cruise along Ibiza’s west coast.














Cruise through San Antonio Bay

Enjoy the calm bay, music on board and views of the coastline before heading towards Ibiza’s west coast beaches.














Cala Bassa, Cala Conta & secret caves

The usual route visits Cala Bassa, Cala Conta and secret caves, with turquoise waters and beautiful coastal scenery.














Alternative route to Cala Salada

If wind or sea conditions are unfavourable, the captain may change the route towards Cala Salada and nearby sheltered coves.














Swimming stop, tapas & drinks

Stop to swim, relax on deck and enjoy Spanish tapas, fresh fruit and drinks included during the trip.














Return to San Antonio

Head back to port after around three hours at sea, having enjoyed one of Ibiza’s most relaxed boat experiences.









Important information


Check-in: 30 minutes before each departure.

Departures: 10:00 / 14:00 / 18:00.

Duration: around 3 hours.

Route: normally Cala Bassa, Cala Conta and secret caves.

Weather policy: the route may change to Cala Salada if wind or sea conditions are unfavourable.
